'''Fruit juice''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] made from [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Menu" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] offered customers the choice of fruit juice made with [[Almakian apple/Legends|Almakian apples]], [[Pallie/Legends|pallie]], [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]], [[Topato/Legends|topatos]], or [[Dressellian prune]]s. The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] charged 2.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for a large serving of fruit juice and 1.7 credits for a small serving.<ref name="Menu" />
